criteria.text:
** Scenario 1: Missing credentials
GIVEN either DM_API_URL or DM_API_KEY is missing,
WHEN I run the live smoke command,
THEN it exits with code 1 and names the missing variable,
AND it does not print the API key.

** Scenario 2: Read-only live commands
GIVEN DM_API_URL and DM_API_KEY are set,
WHEN I run the live smoke command,
THEN it runs the built CLI version, account, filters, fields and estimated-cost property search checks,
AND the local relay blocks requests outside the approved read-only list and checks the source header, User-Agent and authentication.

** Scenario 3: Isolated credentials
GIVEN I run the live smoke command,
WHEN it prepares CLI configuration,
THEN it uses a temporary home and does not access the operator's Keychain or saved CLI settings.
---
Filed by Alma because this work had no Linear ticket. Source: [dealmachine-cli #25](<https://github.com/DealMachine/dealmachine-cli/pull/25>)

checks.title: CLI missing credentials and isolation regression
preconditions: Run the reviewed CLI candidate with the approved Factory executor.
steps: Run the CLI check suite, including the built-CLI smoke regressions.
checks.expected: Missing environment variables exit 1 without printing secrets or making requests; temporary credential setup, failure cleanup and caller settings isolation pass.

checks.title: Built CLI against read-only staging API
preconditions: Run the reviewed CLI candidate with the approved Factory executor.
steps: Run the expanded live smoke on the dedicated staging fixture.
checks.expected: Five built Commands pass, four allowlisted API requests pass header and authentication checks, cost estimation charges no credits, and temporary credentials are removed.
